artists.biography: There are at least two artists with the name 'cleft' or 'Cleft'. 1. A British mathrock 2-piece (active from 2011 to present) 2. A German artist, the brainchild of Sven Brian (active from 2007 to 2009) 1. Cleft are a 2-piece band from Manchester, UK who formed in 2011. They make massive, dirty noises. Their debut EP - 'Utter' - was released on 15th June 2012, with the second called 'Whale Bone' following on the 22nd September 2012. Their debut album called 'BOSH!' was released on the 10th February 2014. http://www.cleftband.co.uk http://www.facebook.com/cleftband http://www.twitter.com/cleftband Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
Cleft’s album Wrong, released in 2016 on Mega Face Records, is a dynamic and inventive entry in the British rock scene, blending elements of math rock, post-rock, and progressive rock. The album is characterized by intricate guitar work, shifting time signatures, and a playful yet technically demanding approach to songwriting. Tracks like “Frankenstein” and “D.O.N.G. 808” showcase the band’s ability to merge complex rhythms with melodic sensibilities, while moments of atmospheric texture and experimental noise add depth to the overall sound.

Wrong stands as a pivotal release in Cleft’s discography, capturing the band at a peak of creative energy and technical prowess. It followed their earlier EPs and built upon their reputation for energetic live performances and genre-defying compositions. The album received positive attention from critics and fans alike, praised for its originality and musicianship, and helped solidify Cleft’s place within the UK’s progressive and alternative rock communities. Though not a mainstream commercial success, Wrong remains a respected and influential work among enthusiasts of math rock and progressive guitar music.
